Marta (Partnerships): FYI: EmberCore accepted the onboarding term sheet. They want broad redistribution for quantized weights and to allow OEM co-branding. Need quick cross-team alignment before we sign. @Diego @Renee
Diego (Legal): We need to tighten redistribution. Propose: named OEMs/channel partners in Appendix C + standard redistribution addendum. If EmberCore insists on a wildcard list, require annual audit and right to revoke.
Renee (Product): Marketplace needs manifest fields: id, version, artifact_types, provenance_url, derived_weights boolean, recommended_precisions. Also a UI warning when derived_weights=true.
Hiro (Engineering): We can deliver fp32, int8, and 4-bit (q4_k) artifacts. We'll include a provenance.json with sha256 checksums and build_date. Note: q4 can have quality delta; will document prompt regressions.
Olga (Solutions): SI ask: prep a reference appliance image and a tiny terraform module. Recommend pilot with NorthStar SI for 5 weeks before broad SI enablement.
Marta (Partnerships): Tentative timeline: legal text Thu, artifacts + checksums Wed, manifest Wed, SI pilot next Mon, announcement 2 weeks after pilot. Any blockers?
Diego (Legal): Blocker: EmberCore wants co-branding on OEM SKUs. If allowed, we need trademark usage terms and example badge placement. Also I'll draft the redistribution clause.
Renee (Product): Add `export_classification` and `allowed_regions` to the manifest to help compliance gating. Also require distributor include the model-card and provenance link in docs.
Hiro (Engineering): Packaging plan: signed tar.gz with `manifest.json` and `provenance.json`. Example manifest keys: name, version, sha256, precision, quant_method, framework, export_classification.
Marta (Partnerships): Action items:
- Diego: finalize redistribution clause + addendum by Thu
- Hiro: build artifacts + provenance + benchmark note by Wed
- Renee: manifest schema + UI warning copy by Wed
- Olga: confirm NorthStar contact and pilot customer by EOD
pm-bot: Calendar event created: "EmberCore joint availability embargo" on 2024-09-20 16:00 UTC (private).
Marta (Partnerships): Thanks team  I'll share EmberCore's answers on co-branding and partner list when I have them. :thumbsup:
